summary: Frontend-only testing of i18n (internationalization) language switcher feature for bilingual EN/FR support. Language toggle works correctly for core navigation, hero section, login page, and most UI elements. FIXED: Vehicles nav item now properly translated to 'Enchères de véhicules'. Remaining issue: Some missing translation keys in 'How It Works' section.

integration_issues.issue: Missing translation keys showing raw keys instead of translated text

action_items: Add missing translation keys to en.json and fr.json for How It Works section: howItWorksTitle, startWinning, browse, browseDesc, bidStep, bidStepDesc, winStep, winStepDesc, learnMore, gettingStarted
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Navbar.js line 66 - Changed hardcoded 'Vehicles' to t('vehicles.vehicleAuctions')
The i18n.js file has comprehensive translations but some keys used in homepage 'How It Works' section are not defined
Language persistence via localStorage works correctly using 'bidvex_language' key

success_rate.frontend: 95% - Core features work, minor missing translations in How It Works section

context_for_next_testing_agent: i18n testing completed. Language switcher (EN|FR toggle) works correctly. French translations verified for: navbar (Accueil, Marché, Enchères par lots), hero section (Découvrez, Misez, Gagnez), trust badges (Paiements sécurisés, Vendeurs vérifiés, Protection de l'acheteur), login page (Bon retour, Courriel, Mot de passe, Se connecter), footer (Politique de Confidentialité, Conditions d'Utilisation). Language preference persists on page refresh via localStorage. Issues: Vehicles nav item not translated, How It Works section shows raw translation keys.

language_toggle_visibility.details: EN|FR toggle visible in navbar with data-testid='language-toggle', data-testid='language-en-btn', data-testid='language-fr-btn'

switch_to_french.details: Clicking FR button switches UI to French. FR button gets bg-primary class when active.

switch_to_english.details: Clicking EN button switches UI back to English. EN button gets bg-primary class when active.

navigation_translations.details: Home→Accueil, Marketplace→Marché, Lots Auction→Enchères par lots, Vehicles→Enchères de véhicules - ALL WORKING

hero_section_translations.details: Discover→Découvrez, Bid→Misez, Win→Gagnez, hero description and buttons translate correctly

trust_badges_translations.details: Secure Payments→Paiements sécurisés, Verified Sellers→Vendeurs vérifiés, Buyer Protection→Protection de l'acheteur

language_persistence.details: Language preference persists on page refresh via localStorage key 'bidvex_language'

login_page_translations.details: Welcome Back→Bon retour, Email→Courriel, Password→Mot de passe, Sign In→Se connecter, Continue with Google→Continuer avec Google

footer_translations.details: Privacy Policy→Politique de Confidentialité, Terms & Conditions→Conditions d'Utilisation, Support→Soutien, All rights reserved→Tous droits réservés

why_choose_section_translations.details: Why Choose BidVex→Pourquoi choisir BidVex, Live Bidding→Enchères en Direct, all feature cards translate

how_it_works_section_translations.details: Shows raw translation keys like 'homepage.howItWorksTitle', 'homepage.browse', 'homepage.bidStep', etc.
